acquisition method: analyzed in Q Exactive HF-X (Thermo Fisher Scientific, San Jose, CA) for DDA (Data Dependent Acquisition) mode detection.
alkylation reagent: alkylated with 55 mM iodoacetamide (45 min in the dark).
alkylation concentration: alkylated with 55 mM iodoacetamide (45 min in the dark).
cleavage agent: proteins (100 µg) of each sample were digested using trypsin (1:20 w/w, Promega, Madison, USA) at 37 ℃ for 4 h.
fractionation method: the eluted peptides were pooled into 20 fractions, which were then freeze-dried.
instrument: analyzed in Q Exactive HF-X (Thermo Fisher Scientific, San Jose, CA)
labeling: iTRAQ-labeling quantitative proteomic analysis was performed.
mass analyzer: Spectra generated by the Orbitrap was optimized by automatic gain control (AGC).
precursor tolerance: The mass tolerance for precursor ions was set as 10 ppm
fragment tolerance: the mass tolerance for fragment ions was set as 0.02 Da.
reduction reagent: The mixtures were reduced with 10 mM DTT (37℃ for 30 min)
reduction concentration: The mixtures were reduced with 10 mM DTT (37℃ for 30 min)
